t: Jess Jessica McClintock perfume - a fragrance for women 1995
s: Jess opens with big, lovely florals. Very similar to Jessica McClintock, Jess has a lot of lily of the valley which gives both frags a nice vintage vibe. Jess doesn't have the persistence and sillage of JMC. Jess ends a bit soapy, a little sweet. It's a very feminine fragrance, suitable for work because of its lack of sillage.

t: Modern Jess Jessica McClintock perfume - a fragrance for women
